acceptance: Accept only the uniform centered statement actually proved; preserve relative, implementability, calibration and continuum limits. Do not promote an upper-bound failure to actual divergence.

definitions.centered: S_lambda(t)=J*exp[-t(H_lambda-e_lambda)/hbar]J; Stilde_lambda(t)=J*exp[-t(Htilde_lambda-etilde_lambda)/hbar]J. Compare in operator norm on all selected H3. Each exact ground energy is a calculated spectral quantity, not a fitted clock or adjustable cancellation.
definitions.controls: Actual inherited graph facts versus finite algebra fixtures; discriminate common-ground assumption, partial energy shifts, omission of complementary leakage, scalar ratios and replacing centered by unshifted error. Check lambda0, time0, units and all uniform-range constants.
definitions.exceptions: At lambda0 both reduce to electric ground and evolution. Uniform absolute centered error still does not imply a relative operator quotient or a measured calibration. Ground-energy subtraction preserves each model evolution convention and is not a change to hbar.
definitions.grounds: e_lambda=inf spec H_lambda; etilde_lambda=inf spec Htilde_lambda. Prove both are isolated simple eigenvalues before using normalized ground vectors or rank-one projections P_g,Ptilde_g. Do not assume the Haar vector is either interacting ground.
definitions.method_freedom: Any rigorous spectral perturbation plus semigroup comparison is allowed. T1 unshifted error cannot simply be multiplied by an unproved common centering factor. Account for unequal energies and nonidentical projections, including limiting t->infinity behavior.
definitions.premises: Inherited physical H_E has unique constant ground and full nonconstant gap3alpha. H-Htilde=alpha lambda QVmagQ, norm bound40alpha lambda, positive and confined to complement. A>=19alpha lambda,C0>=3alpha,||B||=(5/2)alpha lambda. The full finite-graph electric operator has compact resolvent; justify the actual restricted realization if used.
definitions.scales: T1 fixed a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar>0,0<=lambda<=1/100; sigma=alpha*t/hbar; lambda constant. All physical sectors retained.
definitions.sufficient_target: Seek an explicit uniform O(lambda^2) or sharper absolute bound after centering, with energy/projection estimates derived from actual full blocks. A weaker rigorously proved result must be reported at its actual order. A finite-time centered bound alone does not settle the uniform target.
